content: 1. Product Information: Cefoxitin for Injection and Dextrose Injection is available in a 50 mL container as part of the DUPLEX® Drug Delivery System. The product is manufactured by B. Braun Medical Inc. in the USA. DUPLEX® is a registered trademark of B. Braun Medical Inc. 2. Composition: Each 50 mL single-dose unit contains Cefoxitin Sodium USP equivalent to either 1 g or 2 g of cefoxitin, depending on the product variant. The solution also contains approximately 2 g (4% w/v) or 2% w/v of Hydrous Dextrose USP in Water for Injection USP. The approximate osmolality of the solution is 290 mOsmol/kg. 3. Storage Instructions (Prior to Reconstitution): Store the product at 20–25°C (68–77°F). Excursions are permitted between 15–30°C (59–86°F). Ensure the container and seals are intact before use. Do not peel the foil strip until ready for use. After removing the foil strip, the product must be used within 7 days, but not beyond the labeled expiration date. Protect the product from light after the foil strip is removed. 4. Reconstitution Instructions: Hold the container with the set port in a downward direction. Fold the diluent chamber just below the solution meniscus. To activate the seal, squeeze the folded diluent chamber until the seal between the diluent and drug chamber opens, allowing the diluent to flow into the drug chamber. Agitate the reconstituted solution until the drug powder is completely dissolved. Fold the container a second time and squeeze until the seal between the drug chamber and the set port opens. 5. Post-Reconstitution Use: After reconstitution, use the solution only if it is clear and free from particulate matter. If stored at room temperature, use the solution within 12 hours. If stored under refrigeration, use the solution within 7 days. 6. Precautions: Do not use the product in a series connection. Do not introduce additives into the container. Prior to administration, check for minute leaks by squeezing the container firmly. If leaks are found, discard the container and solution as sterility may be compromised. Do not freeze the product. 7. Container Information: The DUPLEX® container is latex-free, PVC-free, and DEHP-free. 8. Inspection and Disposal: Visually inspect the drug prior to reconstitution. Discard the unit if the foil strip is damaged. Peel the foil strip only when ready for use. 9. Additional Information: Refer to the package insert for complete directions on reconstitution and administration. This product is for prescription use only (Rx only). These instructions are intended to ensure the safe and effective use of Cefoxitin for Injection and Dextrose Injection.
